title: Ground source heat pump loop systems.
officialText:
Before connection (header) trenches are backfilled, the assembled loop system
shall be pressure tested with water at 100 psi (689 kPa) for 30 minutes with no observed leaks. Flow and pressure loss testin g shall
be performed and the actual flow rates and pressure drops shall be compared to the calculated design values. If actual flow rate or
pressure drop values differ from calculated design values by more than 10 percent, the problem shall be identified and corrected.
SECTION MC 1209
EMBEDDED PIPING
